arabic text: AAO TABOOT MOHAMMAD KA UTHAAO LOGO
english translation text: OH PEOPLE, COME AND CARRY THE COFFIN OF MUHAMMAD

arabic text: SAARI DUNIYA KO WAFADARI, SIKHAAO LOGO\nAAO TABOOT MOHAMMAD KA UTHAO LOGO
english translation text: TEACH THE WHOLE WORLD THE MEANING OF LOYALTY,\nOH PEOPLE, COME AND CARRY THE COFFIN OF MUHAMMAD

arabic text: JIS AQEEDAT SE BAPA KARTE HO MILAD E NABI\nFARSH E GHUM WESE MOHAMMAD KA, BICHAAO LOGO
english translation text: WITH THE DEVOTION YOU CELEBRATE THE BIRTH OF THE PROPHET,\nO PEOPLE, IN THE SAME WAY COMMEMORATE THE DEMISE OF MUHAMMAD

arabic text: YE SAFAY GHUM HAI MOHAMMAD KI YAHA(N) FARK NAHI\nHA ISI SAFF PE ZAMAANE KO, BULAAO LOGO
english translation text: THIS IS A GATHERING TO MOURN FOR THE PROPHET,\nO PEOPLE, INVITE EVERYONE TO THIS GATHERING TO MOURN FOR MUHAMMAD (SAW)

arabic text: GHAR MEIN HAI FATEMA ZEHRA KE ANDHERA CHAAYA\nAAJ KI RAAT CHARAGHO'N KO, BUJHAAO LOGO
english translation text: THERE IS DARKNESS IN THE HOUSE OF FATIMA (AS)\nO PEOPLE, PUT OUT THE CANDLES TONIGHT

arabic text: KHAAKE PATTHAR BHI JO UMMAT KO DUA DETE RAHE\nAISE MOHSIN KA NA EHSAAN, BHULAAO LOGO
english translation text: EVEN AFTER BEING STONED, HE CARRIED ON PRAYING FOR THE UMMAH\nO PEOPLE, NEVER FORGET THE FAVOURS OF THIS BENEVOLENT MAN

arabic text: APNE GHUM BHOOL KE DETI HAI KHADIJA YE SADA\nAASU ZEHRA KI YATEEMI PE, BAHAAO LOGO
english translation text: FORGETTING HER OWN PAIN, KHADIJA CALLED OUT\nO PEOPLE, SHED TEARS FOR ZAHRA HAS BECOME AN ORPHAN NOW

arabic text: GHUM MEIN MAZLOOM KE RONA HAI NABI KI SUNNAT\nYE HAQIQAT NA ZAMANE SE, CHUPAAO LOGO
english translation text: IT IS THE SUNNAH OF THE PROPHET TO CRY FOR THE OPPRESSED\nO PEOPLE, DO NOT HIDE THIS REALITY FROM ANYONE

arabic text: KYU HO KHAMOSH BAQAIYYA KE UJAR JAANE PAR\nAPNE SARKAAR KO AISE NA, RULAAO LOGO
english translation text: WHY ARE YOU QUIET AFTER THE DESTRUCTION OF BAQEE\nO PEOPLE, DO NOT MAKE THE PROPHET CRY

arabic text: APNE BABA KI JUDAYI MEIN JO CHHUP KAR ROYI\nDIL USI FATEMA ZEHRA KA, BARHAAO LOGO
english translation text: SHE USED TO CRY SECRETLY AFTER BEING SEPARATED FROM HER FATHER\nO PEOPLE, COME & GIVE FATIMA ZAHRA (AS) SOME SUPPORT

arabic text: BAAD BABA KE JISE HAQ NA MILA DUNIYA SE\nUSKE HAQ KE LIYE AWAAZ, UTHAAO LOGO
english translation text: AFTER HER FATHER’S DEATH, SHE DID NOT GET WHAT WAS RIGHTFULLY HERS,\nO PEOPLE, FOR THIS RIGHT OF HERS SPEAK UP
